conditions.condition_text: Determine the higher timeframe bias by identifying if the price is in a premium (above 50% of range) or discount (below 50% of range) zone.
The strategy is based on the principle of buying low and selling high relative to the trading range.
Wait for a liquidity sweep, specifically a major high or low to be purged by a large wick or candle body closure.
Liquidity sweeps signal that resting money has been purged, fueling the next directional move.
Wait for a Break of Structure (BOS) to occur, signaling a significant movement in price.
BOS confirms a potential trading opportunity has been created.
Wait for price to retrace into a Fair Value Gap (FVG) or Imbalance after the BOS.
The market tends to fill inefficiencies (gaps) before continuing its move.
Enter the trade at the 71% retracement level of the measured Fibonacci range.
The 71% retracement is used as the entry point to achieve a favorable risk-to-reward ratio.
The higher timeframe must be aligned with premium (sell) or discount (buy) pricing.
A major high or low must be swept to purge resting liquidity.
A break of structure must occur to signal a potential trading opportunity.
The Fibonacci retracement level must align with a Fair Value Gap or Imbalance.
The initial stop is placed at the extreme high or low of the measured Fibonacci range.
The 71% retracement entry provides a risk-to-reward ratio of 2.45.
